name: A Small Journey
source:
Explore a small world with Avis, a travelling ghost, as she helps the valley's guardian, Willow, find his keys to unlock the passage to a hidden world.

[From [url=https://anizyart.itch.io/a-small-journey]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随四处旅行的幽灵艾维斯，探索一个小小的世界。她将帮助山谷的守护者威洛找回钥匙，打开通往隐秘世界的通道。

[摘自[url=https://anizyart.itch.io/a-small-journey]Itch.io[/url]]
